title: XShell Web Component Contract
description: Describes the public contract of an XShell web component.

properties.description: Public properties exposed by the component.

methods.description: Public methods exposed by the component.

examples.description: Usage examples for documentation and tooling.

valueType.description: Declares the XShell value type expected by a property, event detail field, parameter, or return value.

property.description: Describes a public component property and its XShell runtime behavior.

type.description: Value type accepted by the property.

state.description: Whether the property is backed by component state.

reflect.description: Whether property changes are reflected back to the corresponding HTML attribute.

readonly.description: Whether consumers should treat the property as read-only.

enum.description: Optional set of allowed string values for the property.

attribute.description: Whether the property is exposed as an HTML attribute, or the explicit attribute name to use.

event.description: Describes an event emitted by the component.

description.description: Human-readable description of when and why the event is emitted.

detail.description: Structure of the event's CustomEvent.detail payload.

bubbles.description: Whether the event bubbles through the DOM.

composed.description: Whether the event may cross shadow DOM boundaries.

cancelable.description: Whether the event can be canceled with preventDefault().

eventDetailProperty.description: Describes one field of the event detail payload.

description.description: Human-readable description of the detail field.

type.description: Value type of the detail field.

required.description: Whether the detail field is always present.
